title: Welcome to the Data Capstone Projects!

cues.en: Hello everyone and welcome to the day to have some projects section.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到資料總整專案這一節。

cues.en: Now that we've learned about data analysis and data visualization it's time to combine those two skill sets to tackle real world data sets.
cues.zh: 現在已學過資料分析與視覺化，是時候結合這兩種能力，處理真實世界資料集。

cues.en: Feel free to take your time with these projects and answer questions beyond the scope of the project itself.
cues.zh: 可以慢慢完成這些專案，也歡迎探討超出專案範圍的問題。

cues.en: Thanks so much and I'll see you at the next lecture
